IdempotencyKey.description: UUID v4. Same key and payload replays the stored response; same key with a different payload is 409 DS_IDEMPOTENCY_001. Kept 24 h.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code; clients dispatch on this.

deviceBearer.description: Device token (aud "device-upload", claims device_id and site_id, 24 h). Callable only on artefact routes, GET /v1/scans/{id} and POST /v1/devices/push-token.

userBearer.description: User access JWT (RS256, 15 min). Claims: sub, roles, site_id, deidentify, jti.

Without a token: renewal flow, challenge issued by POST /v1/devices/{id}/renewal-challenge; the App Attest assertion is the credential. An invalid token is 401, never a fall-through to renewal. Exempt from Idempotency-Key: the response is a live bearer credential and is never stored.

x-error-catalog.meaning: The audit record could not be written, so the whole operation was rolled back.
Database-level guard: the audit trigger requires READ COMMITTED isolation. A server defect if it ever surfaces; reported as DS_INTERNAL_001.
Credentials missing, malformed, invalid or expired.
Valid credentials, but the token kind or role is not allowed on this route (including a device token on a user-only route).

Clinician review step-up failed: the review challenge is unknown, expired, already used, issued to someone else or bound to a different scan/action/reason_code/note, or the WebAuthn assertion over it could not be verified. Challenges are single use (spent even on failure): request a new one.
An observation_id or lab id is already in use for a different patient.
The device is not enrolled or has been revoked.
The App Attest assertion counter did not strictly increase (replay).
The challenge is unknown, expired, already used, or was not issued to the caller.
App Attest attestation or assertion verification failed.
This App Attest key_id is already enrolled.
The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request payload.
The Idempotency-Key header (UUID v4) is missing or malformed.
A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress; retry later.
Unexpected server error. The response carries no internal detail.
No such route, or the resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller (access denial on a resource is reported as 404, never 403).
The scan has not passed the quality gate (status is not quality_passed).
Maximum recaptures reached for a step; the step is marked UNABLE_TO_ACQUIRE. detail lists unable_to_acquire, recaptured and the new scan status.
Too many outstanding renewal challenges for this device.
Regulatory hold: no valid primary-research consent (none recorded, withdrawn, or not primary research).
The patient consented to a superseded consent version; re-consent is required.
Another non-revoked scan for this patient was captured within 30 minutes of captured_at.
client_session_id is already used for a different scan.
The scan status does not allow this operation (illegal transition).
Database-level guard: an immutable scan column was changed. A server defect if it ever surfaces; reported as DS_INTERNAL_001.
Database-level guard: the acting role lacks authority for the scan transition. Reported as DS_INTERNAL_001 if it ever surfaces.
The uploaded object sha256 does not match the declared value; the artefact is marked rejected.
No such step attempt exists for this scan.
The artefact was already declared with a different sha256.
The artefact status does not accept upload parts.

The upload is incomplete: the uploaded parts add up to fewer bytes than size_bytes (detail: received_bytes, size_bytes). Retryable: upload the missing parts and complete again (the same Idempotency-Key may be reused). The artefact status is unchanged.
Request validation failed (unknown field, wrong type, out of range). detail.issues lists the problems.
